The employee sustained fractures to their left shoulder and shoulder blade, and an electrical burn to their ring finger.
An employee was installing solar panels when they became ill and sustained heat exhaustion and dehydration.

EventTitle: Other fall to lower level  less than 6 feet
Final Narrative: An employee was holding a piece of sheet metal while standing on the second rung from the bottom of a ladder. A gust of wind caused the employee to fall from the ladder to the ground, striking his head. The employee sustained a head injury, lost consciousness, and was hospitalized.
An employee was climbing a pole to do storm repair work when an electrical arc occurred. The employee sustained burns to the left side of their neck, shoulder, and arm.

EventTitle: Struck by suspended or swinging objects  n.e.c.
Final Narrative: An employee was helping to install concrete forms when a form that was being flown in began swaying due to a gust of wind. While trying to maintain control of the form, the employee's arm was pinched between the previously installed form and the one being set, resulting in a broken forearm.

EventTitle: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.
Final Narrative: Employees were working on storm repairs to power lines. Frozen components of the crossarms of the power line supports failed; the primary conductors broke and fell against a tree and onto the ground. A ground crew member was struck in the head by either a section of a tree limb, communications cable, or one of the broken primary conductors. The employee sustained blunt force trauma to the head.

An employee was conducting maintenance on residential solar panels and started to experience cramps in their thighs and calves. They became ill due to high temperatures on the job site and sustained a heat illness.

EventTitle: Struck by other falling object  n.e.c.
Final Narrative: Employees were responding to power outages caused by a storm. The injured employee was surveying the damage near an area where power lines were suspected to be down. An adjacent tree fell and struck the injured employee. He sustained internal and crushing injuries, including liver bruising and internal bleeding. He also sustained a broken arm and required surgery.
An employee worked all day outside and started cramping. The employee was hospitalized for heat-related illness.

EventTitle: Struck by propelled object or substance  unspecified
Final Narrative: On 6/11/2025, a lineman was removing a dead tree off of a powerline that had fallen due to thunderstorms. The employee cut the top of the tree to lessen the weight of the tree. He then hooked a jib line to the tree to lift it off the power line and place it on the ground. As he was moving his bucket into position, the tree shifted and fell, and the powerline released its tension. This caused a whipping effect and either the power line or the jib rope struck the employee's jaw. The employee was hospitalized with two fractures to his lower jaw.
After working all day in the heat and sun, an employee became ill and was hospitalized for heat stroke.

On June 25, 2025, an employee was installing wooden guardrail posts at a work site when they began exhibiting signs of heat-related illness. The employee was transported back to the company shop and was taken to the hospital for treatment.
An employee was working in a high-heat environment installing solar panels. The employee sustained heat exhaustion / heat stroke and was hospitalized.
An employee was working outdoors in the heat, cleaning rock ballast off crossties, when he developed leg cramps. He was hospitalized, suffering from rhabdomyolysis.
An employee felt lightheaded and exhausted after climbing a pole during training. The employee was taken to the hospital for heat-related illness.
An employee was cleaning up a job site during a 12-hour shift and developed heat-related illness.
An employee was moving lumber around a job site when he experienced symptoms of heat exhaustion and called an ambulance. He was hospitalized and received treatment for heat exhaustion.

An employee was backfilling a line trench after filling in lines. While shoveling dirt to fill the hole, the employee began experiencing signs of heat stress. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.

An employee was in a man basket working on stripping an overhang under a bridge in temperatures above 90 degrees. The employee started experiencing cramping and felt ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion.
An employee was part of a crew tasked to replace a gas service. The heat index for the day reached a peak of 102 F, and the employee sustained a heat-related injury resulting in hospitalization.
On July 29, 2025, an employee was operating a jackhammer to remove an old concrete sidewalk. After the work day was complete, the employee was hospitalized with heat-related illness.
On July 30, 2025, an employee was building a false work flooring for a bridge cap when he started cramping due to heat. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.
An employee had been preparing material for a lineman at a jobsite and was pulling up wire on a hand line. The employee began to feel ill, suffering from heat illness.
While running a hand compaction device on a jobsite, an employee developed severe cramps and became ill. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
